messages:
Avery: Thanks everyone for joining today's all-hands. Opening this thread for Q&A/clarifications on product roadmap items we covered — specifically API streaming perf, Console model-level metrics, and Optimize recommendations timeline. Drop questions and we'll answer.

Priya: Quick clarifications — API streaming optimization (v2 streaming) is targeted for end of May; Console model-level metrics (per-model latency/cost) beta mid-June; Optimize quantization advisor GA late Q3. I'll post a more detailed schedule + canary plan later today.

Marco: Engineering note — streaming perf depends on kernel rollout and a couple of attention optimizations. Plan is: 2-week canary on Dedicated, then hosted rollout in waves. There are some infra migrations required for low-latency path.

Sam: SDK/DevEx note — we'll add a new param `streaming_mode: 'low_latency'` while keeping current defaults backward-compatible. SDK 1.5.0 will contain the ergonomic helpers and examples. Docs and migration guide will ship with that release.

Jordan: Quick question — what does this mean for Dedicated customers? timeline for reserved pools and will they need config changes?

Priya: Dedicated customers will be offered opt-in to the canary in week 1 of the canary. No forced config changes expected; we will expose an optional knob in Console labeled "strict latency" to opt into the low-latency runtime.

Casey: For Optimize -> quantization advisor: will the quality/regression alerts be tied into our evals framework? we need to ensure we don't regress generation quality when recommending quantized variants.

Marco: Yes — Optimize will integrate with the evals pipeline. Quantization recommendations run against a user-provided prompt set and we run regression checks. Alerts funnel into Console Alerts and the Rollouts page.

Sam: I'll own the docs + quickstart for Optimize evals. Draft will be in the docs repo by next Tuesday.

Nora-bot: Recording + slides uploaded to All-Hands folder — https://internal.redwood/notes/all-hands-2026-03-23 

DevRel-Bot: Roadmap doc & RFCs: https://go.redwood/roadmap-api-console-optimize  | RFCs referenced: rfc-2341 (streaming), rfc-2399 (optimize-qa)

Avery: Action items recap — Priya to publish the timeline doc by Friday, Marco to open canary runbook and share risk matrix, Sam to draft SDK/docs PR. Ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:

Jordan: +1, will coordinate with Sales/Customer Success on opt-in messaging and customer comms.

Casey: One more: will Console beta include a per-model cost breakdown (tokens + estimated monthly spend)? that will be key for customers.

Priya: Yes — the Console beta includes per-model token cost, projected monthly cost estimates, and a model comparison view. We'll show sample billing views in the beta.

Sam: Adding a quick `curl` example for the new streaming param to the docs draft:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-medium","streaming_mode":"low_latency","input":"Tell me a joke."}'
```

Avery: Thanks all — this thread will be converted into a short follow-up doc and shared with the company. If you volunteered for action items above, please add a short comment here once you start. Closing thread.
